entries.speaker: Ann
entries.en: You're going to apologize when Mona[n]comes, all right?

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: I know already! And why're you just[n]sayin' that to me!?

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: We need to be wary of the Beauty Thief[n]too.

entries.speaker: Yusuke
entries.en: So we're doing a stakeout here.

entries.speaker: Futaba
entries.en: We better be ready for the long haul!

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: Ain't he gonna show up today? I mean,[n]what time is it now?

entries.speaker: Yusuke
entries.en: Hold that thought.

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: You guys are seriously slacking off[n]way too much!

entries.speaker: Haru
entries.en: Do you have business with us?

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: Aren't you fulfilling the requests on[n]the Phantom Aficionado Website?[n]Even leaving comments?

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: It'd be best if you don't accept them so[n]recklessly.

entries.speaker: Yusuke
entries.en: The police will track you down in no[n]time. If that were to happen, we'd be[n]caught up in it as well.

entries.speaker: Haru
entries.en: That's not what I intended!

entries.speaker: Haru
entries.en: But... that would be my fault...

entries.speaker: Haru
entries.en: I'm actually not that great with[n]machines... I'm truly sorry.

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: Why're you apologizing!?

entries.speaker: Haru
entries.en: They're telling us for our sake. We should[n]be thanking them.

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: Won't you please put what happened[n]behind us?

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: So I'm the one you're here for?

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: You guys need me after all? Is that it?
You're vital to our team.
Please come back.

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: Really?

entries.speaker: Ann
entries.en: Ryuji!

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: Eh... I guess we could still use you.

entries.speaker: Ann
entries.en: Ryuji!

entries.speaker: Ann
entries.en: We're sorry too, Morgana. We weren't[n]taking your feelings into consideration[n]at all.

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: Lady Ann...

entries.speaker: Haru
entries.en: E-Everyone, shouldn't you be using[n]code names?

entries.speaker: Ann
entries.en: Ryuji didn't really mean what he said,[n]you know? He wants to apologize...

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: Well, it's like... It was my bad too...

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: I mean, I don't mind if you're not human[n]or if you're useless!

entries.speaker: Futaba
entries.en: What a douche...

entries.speaker: Yusuke
entries.en: Ann's setup was completely ruined.

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: Oh, is that right!? So I AM just some[n]useless cat to you guys!

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: You're so full of yourselves, but do you[n]have the skills to back that up!?

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: Try and catch me then!

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: Get in, Beauty Thief!

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: If you can't do this, don't count on me[n]ever coming back!

entries.speaker: Futaba
entries.en: There they go...

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: Did he even think about how long he[n]made us wait!? Fine, we'll do this!

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: Geez! This isn't what we came here[n]to do!
